description: The five end-to-end journeys that QR7.1 tracks. Each entry names the integration test that guards the journey. CriticalPathInventoryTests asserts every name resolves to a live, unskipped test in this assembly, so renaming or deleting one of these tests fails the build instead of silently shrinking the gate. Add a path only when its test exercises the real API and database.

paths.description: Register with an invite, verify the destination, log in, recover, and log out.
An admin approves an invite request, which produces a protected outbox entry, and a resend rotates the invite.
Creating an alias mints an address and publishes the owner's destination to the Worker's KV namespace.
The Worker's ingest call records a message that the owner can then read back.
A request for another account's alias is refused rather than answered.
